contributions.statement: Do not expect a feature-clustered code graph to beat plain dense retrieval on functional correctness; it improved dependency recall but Pass@1 was within about 1 point of UniXcoder RAG.
contributions.evidence: Table 3: Pass@1 42.24 vs 41.40 (UniXcoder) and 42.31 (CodexGraph) on DeepSeek; 55.03 vs 56.35 (CodexGraph) on GPT-5-mini; no ablation; Python only.

reason: Retrieval-metric wins with no functional gain over dense RAG, no ablation, Python only; nothing a team could act on beyond what other graph-context papers show.
